# Cooperative control: pause only immediately after a fully verified checkpoint.
# No row/cursor is skipped and a running span is never interrupted.
if not globals().get('_mathvision_pause_controller_installed',False):
    _mathvision_original_consume=audit_v3.FullArchiveAudit.consume
    _mathvision_pause_requested=False
    def _mathvision_checkpoint_boundary_consume(self,entry,path,*args,**kwargs):
        if _mathvision_pause_requested:
            verified=full_audit_worker_state.get('checkpoint')
            if verified and verified.get('fresh_raw_readback_verified') and self.report()==verified['report_at_snapshot']:
                full_audit_worker_state['state']='PAUSED_AT_VERIFIED_CHECKPOINT_FOR_VALIDATED_PERFORMANCE_UPGRADE'
                full_audit_worker_state['pause_reason']='Exact batched tokenization and less frequent large checkpoint copies; no data changes.'
                write_worker_status()
                raise SystemExit('Cooperative data-audit pause at fully verified checkpoint')
        return _mathvision_original_consume(self,entry,path,*args,**kwargs)
    audit_v3.FullArchiveAudit.consume=_mathvision_checkpoint_boundary_consume
    _mathvision_pause_controller_installed=True
print({'pause_controller_installed':_mathvision_pause_controller_installed,'pause_requested':_mathvision_pause_requested,'training_started':False})
